name: 3D Medical Manufacturing by TECOMET
old_description: Together, with our technical expertise and focus on precision, we’ll help you create quality, innovative solutions that meet your most complex manufacturing needs.
about:
Tecomet, headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida, operates as a contract manufacturer with a legacy spanning more than 50 years. The company combined with Orchid in a merger that brought together two organizations to expand global manufacturing capabilities.

The company provides end-to-end manufacturing services for medical device and aerospace customers, including precision CNC machining, Swiss turning, forging, in-house tool design, laser processing, and sterile cleanroom assembly. Its footprint comprises 24 manufacturing campuses across six countries, staffed by approximately 3,500 employees. Services range from product ideation and prototyping to full-scale production and packaging support.

Tecomet serves leading medical device companies, focusing on orthopedic applications such as shoulder, spine, trauma, hip, knee, and minimally invasive surgical instruments. The aerospace segment is also noted in its manufacturing solutions portfolio. Customers engage the firm for collaborative development programs, including the proprietary LaunchRight process for high-touch design and upfront engineering.

The company emphasizes its scalable, end-to-end capabilities, rigorous quality standards, and commitment to innovation as key differentiators. Proprietary technologies and a collaborative partnership model are positioned to solve complex manufacturing challenges and accelerate time to market.
